# Ruff for the two Python simulator lint legs, which have no lockfile of their own.
# A requirements file rather than an inline `pip install ruff==...`: Renovate's
# pip_requirements manager reads this path but cannot see a version inside a `run:`
# block — the same reason requirements-lint.txt exists.
#
# Kept equal to the version devices/ap-collector/uv.lock resolves, so a rule that passes
# locally passes in CI. Unpinned, a ruff release turns these legs red with no code change.
#
# Separate from requirements-lint.txt so the simulator legs do not install zizmor too.
ruff==0.16.5
